# SCI-MAP r0.3 document build recipe

This recipe builds three contract PDFs from an isolated copy of the author sources. It does not build or inspect the application. Scientific-owner acceptance and freeze are separate from the document checks below.

1. Use the local Python executable `/Users/gwilson/tolteca/bin/python -B` to run `tools/build_packet.py prepare --package <package> --attempt <new-absolute-directory>`. Preparation requires all 136 input digests to match, copies the author sources into a new directory, and generates exact cover identities.
2. In the attempt's source directory, run the exact Tectonic command recorded in `BUILD_ATTEMPT.json` for each of the three view entry sources, with `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1788825600` and `TZ=UTC`. Use `--only-cached --untrusted --keep-logs --keep-intermediates` with `--makefile-rules <view-output>/dependencies.mk` and distinct clean output directories. Retain stdout, stderr, and the TeX log. The cached mode forbids fetching dependencies; no application configuration or build is involved.
3. Run `tools/build_packet.py inspect --attempt <attempt>`. This reopens every PDF through pypdf, extracts every page, checks the TeX log, records PDF metadata using Poppler, and renders every page independently with Poppler at 100 dpi. Inspect every rendered page for clipping, collisions, broken tables, and readability; inspect full-resolution pages whenever a contact sheet leaves uncertainty.
4. Copy the successful exact source tree, generated identity fragments, PDF outputs, build-attempt and inspection records, and retained compile/metadata logs into the candidate packet. Record visual inspection separately from the mechanical results; do not label prospective ECS evidence as executed.
5. Run `tools/seal_packet.py --package <package>` and `tools/verify_packet.py --package <package> --report <external-report>`. The verifier consumes only this document package.
6. Create the delivery archive outside the package using `tools/seal_packet.py --package <package> --archive <new-archive-path> --archive-only`. The archive operation verifies every member byte against the package and writes an exact SHA256 sidecar. A final independent review binds the committed candidate and external delivery evidence.

The shared-core digest concatenates, in the recorded order, each source's UTF-8 relative path, a NUL, its ASCII raw byte length, a NUL, its raw bytes, and a final NUL. Raw wrapper and module digests are also published. PDF covers bind raw entry-source bytes, the separate shared-core bundle, the exact input manifest/addendum/directive, and the predetermined build-attempt identity. Generated covers and the final build result are sealed afterward, avoiding self-hash cycles.

`BUILD_ATTEMPT.json` records the observed executable paths, versions, executable SHA256 values, operating system, Python executable, source digests, flags, and fixed PDF date epoch. `PDF_BUILD_INSPECTION.json` records the reader libraries and observed output bytes. TeX recorder inputs are retained when the compiler emits them. These records describe the actual local document build; they do not assert cross-host bit reproducibility, application conformance, Spack qualification, or Unity activity.
